acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Gel-based experiment; Bottom-up proteomics; Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: Quantitative mass spectrometry: Proteins affinity-purified from mitochondrial fractions generated from differentially “heavy” (Arg10/Lys8) or “light” (Arg0/Lys0) SILAC labeled HEK293 wildtype cells (control) or from cells that expressed the FLAG-tagged TRABD were combined, separated by SDS-PAGE and processed for LC-MS analysis including reduction and alkylation of cysteine residues and tryptic in-gel digestion as described before (Dewar et al. 2022, J Biol Cell 298; Peikert et al. 2017, Nat Commun 8).
